name: orbit
description: Orbit Engineering for Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity: From Goal to Verified Outcome — context, requirements, sandboxes, runtime, UI tests, autonomous QA, Orbit Control, MCP and tools. Governed and local. No dependencies.

working_set.title: Record the working set
working_set.description: After each Read, Edit, Write, Grep, Glob or Bash call, keep one line of metadata about what this session touched: repo-relative paths, a class per command, pass or fail. Never file contents, command arguments, tool output or prompts. Kept outside every repository and expired after 7 days. An exported ORBIT_WORKING_SET overrides this on one machine.

engineering_observe.title: Learn how this project builds code
engineering_observe.description: On by default. At a milestone only (a commit, the end of a session, a check passing after an edit, a task that completed on its own proof), propose engineering facts from file names and the checks that passed. Every proposal is reconciled: one session is only ever 'possible', and nothing it proposes can be adopted or enforced. Only a checkout somebody used Orbit in is observed. Needs the working set. Turn it off here, or with ORBIT_ENGINEERING_OBSERVE=off on one machine.

prompt_router.title: Route each prompt to what can help
prompt_router.description: Before each prompt, a UserPromptSubmit hook adds at most 2 KB naming the skills, agents, MCP servers, CLI tools and capabilities that are relevant and usable here, and what is relevant but missing. It only recommends: it never starts, calls or installs anything, reads only local snapshots, and never stores the prompt. At session start it also re-reads the host's MCP configuration and detects tools, in the background. An exported ORBIT_PROMPT_ROUTER overrides this on one machine.

trace.title: Keep the session trail
trace.description: Record, on this machine only, what each session did through Orbit: for every prompt a salted fingerprint, its length and what the prompt router decided; which skills and agents started; which Orbit commands (and which classes of other command) ran and whether they passed; which tools were used; where a turn ended. Never a prompt's text, a response, a command's arguments, a tool's output, a path or a file's contents. Orbit Control's Trace and Analytics pages read it. Kept 90 days, never sent anywhere. An exported ORBIT_TRACE overrides this on one machine.

host_memory.title: Use the host's project memory as hints
host_memory.description: At session start, remember where Claude Code keeps its own memory for this project (the location only), so project knowledge can use those notes as hints for a task: never as facts, never copied into Orbit's store, and always outranked by what current source shows. An exported ORBIT_HOST_MEMORY overrides this on one machine.
